characters.name: Ruti
characters.description: Girl of about 5, small and lively, sun-tanned olive skin, bright brown eyes, two thick light-brown braids tied with green ribbons. Wears a short-sleeved red-and-white checked dress over white leggings and brown sandals; at kindergarten the same dress. Signature item: a wide straw sun hat with a green ribbon.

characters.name: Abba
characters.description: Ruti's father, a moshav farmer of about 38, strong and broad, sun-tanned skin, crinkly smiling brown eyes, short brown beard, a green knitted kippah. Wears a faded blue work shirt with rolled sleeves, khaki work trousers and brown work boots. Signature item: a small hand sickle with a wooden handle.

characters.name: Noam
characters.description: Ruti's little brother, toddler of about 2, chubby cheeks, light-brown curls, big round eyes. Wears a yellow T-shirt with a small duck and blue shorts.

characters.name: Dana
characters.description: Girl of about 5 at Ruti's kindergarten, shy, dark-brown skin, big gentle eyes, black hair in many small puffs with white clips. Wears a purple T-shirt and a pink skirt.

characters.name: Yoav
characters.description: Boy of about 5 at Ruti's kindergarten, slim, fair skin, blue eyes, straight blond hair, a small blue kippah with a clip. Wears an orange T-shirt and grey shorts.

cover.prompt: Ruti in her straw sun hat stands at the edge of a golden wheat field in the late afternoon sun, proudly spreading her arms toward one tall corner of wheat left uncut, while the rest of the field is harvested. Behind her, Abba smiles with his hands on his hips. Rolling moshav fields and a blue sky. Warm golden light, wide medium shot.

pages.prompt: A tall golden-yellow wheat field on a moshav on a bright summer morning. Ruti stands in it wearing her straw sun hat, the wheat stalks reaching almost to her shoulders; she grins with excitement, touching the ears of wheat. Abba walks in from the side holding his small hand sickle. Blue sky, distant hills and orchards, wide shot.

Abba cuts wheat with his hand sickle, bending over the row, while Ruti gathers armfuls of stalks and bundles them into sheaves. Behind them the field is now short and stubbly, row after row; in the far corner one patch still stands tall and golden. Midday sun, busy cheerful working scene, wide medium shot.

Ruti points excitedly at the tall uncut corner of the field, calling out to Abba with her mouth wide open. Abba straightens up from his work, wipes his forehead and smiles knowingly at her. Golden stubble field around them, the tall corner bright in the sunlight. Medium shot, lively mood.

Abba crouches beside Ruti next to the tall corner of wheat and gestures gently toward a dirt road at the edge of the field, where in the distance a simple-looking man with a cloth bag walks toward the field. Ruti looks curiously in that direction. Warm afternoon light, calm and kind mood.

Abba and Ruti sit together on a bale of wheat sheaves at the edge of the field, resting. Abba speaks warmly with one hand on his heart, Ruti listening with her head tilted. Around them the harvested field and the golden corner shine in the late light. Soft, warm, reflective mood, medium shot.

Still sitting on the sheaves, Ruti looks up with a questioning face, and Abba spreads his arm wide toward the moshav houses, gardens and neighbors in the distance, including a neighbor waving from a porch. Ruti smiles as she begins to understand. Golden hour light, wide medium shot.

In a cozy moshav kitchen, Ruti stands by the table with three cookies on a plate in front of her. She holds one cookie in each hand and carefully leaves the third on the plate, glancing toward her little brother Noam, who toddles in with his arms reaching out happily. Warm late-afternoon light, home details: a mezuzah, a fruit bowl.

A sunny kindergarten yard with a colorful swing set and sandbox. Children run toward the swings. Ruti, sitting on one swing, waves and calls warmly to Dana, who stands alone and shy at the side, pointing to the free swing next to her that she has saved. Bright morning light, cheerful wide shot.

Ten o'clock snack time at a small kindergarten table. Yoav sits with a sad face and an empty lunchbox. Ruti, sitting beside him, tears her pita in two and holds out half to him with a kind smile. Yoav's face starts to brighten. Other children eat in the background. Warm indoor light, close medium shot.

Evening on the porch of the moshav house, warm sunset sky. Ruti stands in front of Abba, counting excitedly on her fingers and telling him all about her day, eyes sparkling. Abba sits on the porch step listening with a proud smile. Little Noam plays with a toy nearby. Golden-orange light, cozy family scene.

Abba lifts Ruti high up in the air like a tall wheat stalk, her braids and dress flying, both of them laughing. Behind them, the golden field and the tall uncut corner glow in the last sunset light. Ruti's arms are spread wide with joy. Low camera angle, warm sky, joyful mood.

A warm closing scene in the kindergarten yard: Ruti shares a piece of candy with Dana, Yoav sits beside them on a bench with a big smile, and little Noam waves from his stroller at the gate. Everyone smiles at each other. Sunny, colorful, friendly mood, wide medium shot.
